headline: WSN @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.16 at BAL 5.34, with a projected total of 9.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: WSN moved -0.34 runs while BAL moved +0.62, changing the projected margin by -0.95 runs. NRFI probability dropped -7.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kyle Bradish has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nasim Nuñez, Dylan Crews, Taylor Ward, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Wood because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
